name: Salesforce Administrator

sections.name: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder

notes: Banco de 4 pruebas reales hechas en oct 2025 (las pantallas muestran 7 áreas del examen de Administrador de Salesforce). Hay preguntas de elegir 2 o 3. Las respuestas de la prueba 1 salen de la clave de un examen aprobado; las demás se basan en lo marcado por quien hizo la prueba y pueden contener errores (llevan una nota cuando hay duda).

questions.q: Cloud Kicks wants to update a screen flow so that if the checkbox field High Value Customer is set to true, the first screen is skipped and the user is directed to the second screen. How should the administrator configure the decision element?
o: Use the equals operator and "High Value Customer" as the value.
Use the contains operator and "High Value Customer" as the value.
Use the equals operator and {!$GlobalConstant.True} as the value.
Use the contains operator and {!$GlobalConstant.False} as the value.
questions.e: Un checkbox es booleano: en el Decision se compara con {!$GlobalConstant.True}, no con el texto del nombre del campo.

questions.q: The administrator for Cloud Kicks has created a screen flow to help service reps ask the same set of questions when customers call in with issues. This screen should be visible from cases. How should the screen flow be distributed?
o: Component Filter
Home Page
Page Layout
Lightning Page
questions.e: Un screen flow se incrusta en una Lightning Page (componente Flow) para que lo vean los agentes en el registro.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks needs to be able to show different picklist values for sales and marketing users. Which two options will meet this requirement?
o: One record type, two profiles, one picklist
One page layout, two record types, one picklist
Two permission sets, one record type, one picklist
Two page layouts, one record type, two picklists
questions.e: Los valores por perfil se controlan con record types: un layout con dos record types y una picklist, o dos layouts con un record type y dos picklists.

questions.q: The administrator at Cloud Kicks writes an assignment rule to send all cases created via email or the web to the Automated Cases Queue. Any manually created cases should be owned by the agent creating them; however, the manually created cases now show the administrator as the owner. What will the administrator find when troubleshooting this issue?
o: The Owner field is missing on the webform and email template.
An escalation rule is changing the case owner on case creation.
The Assignment Rule checkbox is selected by default.
Another assignment rule is giving ownership to the administrator.
questions.e: La casilla "Assign using active assignment rules" viene marcada por defecto en la creación; hay que desmarcarla o crear los casos manuales con otra lógica.

questions.q: The marketing team wants a new picklist value added to the Campaign Member Status field for the upsell promotional campaign. Which two solutions should the administrator use to modify the picklist field values?
o: Edit the picklist values for the Campaign Status in Object Manager.
Add the Campaign Member Statuses related list to the Page Layout.
Mass modify the Campaign Member Statuses related list.
Modify the picklist value on the Campaign Member Statuses related list.
questions.e: Para añadir estados de miembro hay que mostrar la lista relacionada Campaign Member Statuses en el layout y editar sus valores ahí.

questions.q: Ursa Major Solar is noticing a decrease in deals with a cross-sell opportunity type and wants to share all cross-sell opportunities with a team of subject matter experts in their organization. The company has different roles, and the organization-wide default for Opportunity is set to Private. How should the administrator accomplish this?
o: Add the subject matter experts to a public group and give them access to the records with a criteria-based sharing rule.
Change the organization-wide default for Opportunity from Private to Public Read/Write to open up access for the subject matter experts.
Create a new role for the subject matter experts and give them access to the records with an owner-based sharing rule.
Enable territory management, assign the subject matter experts to the same territory, and give them access to the records with manual sharing.
questions.e: Un grupo público con los expertos más una regla de uso compartido basada en criterios (tipo de oportunidad = cross-sell) les da acceso.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to calculate how much revenue has been generated for each of its marketing campaigns. How should an administrator deliver this information?
o: Design a standard Campaign report and add the Value Won Opportunities in Campaign field.
Add a Total Value field on Campaign and use a workflow rule to update the value when an opportunity is won.
Create a roll-up summary field on Opportunity to Campaign.
Perform periodic data jobs to update campaign records.
questions.e: El informe estándar de Campañas con "Value Won Opportunities in Campaign" muestra el ingreso generado por campaña.

questions.q: Universal Containers requires that when an opportunity is closed won, all other open opportunities on the same account must be marked as closed lost. Which automation solution should an administrator use to implement this request?
o: Outbound Message
Workflow Rule
Flow Builder
Quick Action
questions.e: Actualizar otros registros relacionados al cerrar una oportunidad se automatiza con un flow desencadenado por registro.

questions.q: An administrator at Cloud Kicks wants to deactivate a user who has left the company. What are two reasons that would prevent a user from being deactivated?
o: The user is in a custom hierarchy field.
The user is part of a territory hierarchy.
The user is the highest role in the role hierarchy.
The user is the sole recipient of a workflow email alert.
questions.e: No se puede desactivar a un usuario que es el único destinatario de una alerta de email de workflow ni el que aparece en un campo de jerarquía personalizada.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters has two different sales processes: one for business opportunities with four stages and one for partner opportunities with eight stages. Both processes will vary in page layouts and picklist value options. What should an administrator configure to meet these requirements?
o: Different page layouts that control the picklist values for the opportunity types
Public groups to limit record types and sales processes for opportunities
Separate record types and sales processes for the different types of opportunities
Validation rules that ensure that users are entering accurate sales stage information
questions.e: Cada proceso de venta tiene sus etapas; se asocian a record types distintos de Opportunity.

questions.q: An administrator at DreamHouse Realty needs to create customized pages for the Salesforce mobile app. Which two types of pages could an administrator build and customize using the Lightning App Builder?
o: Record page
User page
Dashboard page
App page
questions.e: En la app móvil se pueden crear páginas de registro y de aplicación con el Lightning App Builder.

questions.q: The service manager at Ursa Major Solar wants to let customers know that they have received their cases via email and their website. Medium-priority and high-priority cases should receive different email notifications than low-priority cases. The administrator has created three email templates for this purpose. How should an administrator configure this requirement?
o: Include three assignment rules that fire when cases are created. Add a filter for case priority. Select the appropriate email template for each rule.
Add three auto-response rules. Configure one rule entry criteria for each rule and set a filter for case priority. Select the appropriate email template for each rule entry.
Configure one workflow rule that fires when cases are created. Add a filter for case priority. Select the appropriate email template for the rule.
Create one auto-response rule. Configure three rule entry criteria and set a filter for case priority. Select the appropriate email template for each rule entry.
questions.e: Una sola regla de auto-respuesta con varias entradas de regla (por prioridad) envía la plantilla adecuada a cada caso.

questions.q: At Cloud Kicks, sales reps use discounts on the opportunity record to help win sales on particular products. When an opportunity is won, they then have to manually apply the discount to the related opportunity products. The sales manager has asked if there is a way to automate this time-consuming task. What should the administrator use to deliver this requirement?
o: Flow Builder
Prebuilt Macro
Formula Field
Approval Process
questions.e: Aplicar descuentos a los productos de la oportunidad al ganarla es una automatización de varios registros: flow desencadenado por registro.

questions.q: The VP of sales at AW Computing would like sales reps to check in with their top account every Monday. The VP would like a dashboard component to show the status of the check-ins. What should the administrator configure to remind the reps to contact their top account?
o: Use a process email alert on the account.
Enable the creation of recurring tasks.
Create a time-based workflow task.
Add the email action to the page layout.
questions.e: Las tareas recurrentes (Enable Creation of Recurring Tasks) permiten el seguimiento semanal y alimentan el componente de dashboard.

questions.q: DreamHouse Realty regularly holds open houses for the selling of both houses and condominiums. For condominium open houses, there are a few extra steps that need to be taken. Agents need to be able to submit requests and receive approvals from the homeowners' association. How can the administrator ensure these extra steps only appear when creating open house records for condominiums?
o: Create two page layouts. Use processes and record types to display the appropriate picklist values.
Create two page layouts, one with a House Status field and the other with a Condominium Status field.
Create one page layout. Use business processes to ensure the proper status picklist values display.
Create one page layout. Use record types to ensure the proper status picklist values display.
questions.e: Dos layouts y record types (con perfiles/processes) muestran los pasos extra solo en los open houses de condominios.

questions.q: An administrator at Northern Trail Outfitters is creating a validation rule. Which two functions should the administrator use when creating a validation rule?
o: Rule active date
Error message location
Formula return type
Error condition formula
questions.e: Una regla de validación se compone de la fórmula de condición de error y de la ubicación del mensaje de error.

questions.q: What are two considerations an administrator should keep in mind when working with Salesforce objects?
o: A new standard object can be created.
Standard objects are included with Salesforce.
Custom and standard objects have standard fields.
Only standard objects support master-detail relationships.
questions.e: Los objetos estándar vienen con Salesforce y tanto los estándar como los personalizados traen campos estándar.

questions.q: When a sales rep clicks a button on an opportunity, a simple discount calculator screen should be launched. Which automation tool should an administrator use to build this discount calculator screen?
o: Workflow Rule
Flow Builder
Process Builder
Platform Event
questions.e: Una pantalla lanzada desde un botón (acción) es un screen flow, la herramienta adecuada para calculadoras simples.

questions.q: Universal Containers has two sales teams, sales team A and sales team B. Each team has their own role in the role hierarchy. Both roles are subordinates of the same Manager role. How should the administrator share records owned by sales team A with sales team B?
o: Use manual sharing
Criteria-based sharing
Owner-based sharing
Hierarchical sharing
questions.e: Para que dos equipos del mismo nivel compartan sin dar acceso por jerarquía se usa una regla de reparto basada en propietario (owner-based).

questions.q: Sales reps at Ursa Major Solar are having difficulty managing deals. The leadership team has asked the administrator to help sales reps prioritize and close more deals. What should the administrator configure to help with these issues?
o: Einstein Search Personalization
Einstein Lead Scoring
Einstein Activity Capture
Einstein Opportunity Scoring
questions.e: Einstein Lead Scoring prioriza los leads según probabilidad de conversión; para oportunidades sería Opportunity Scoring.

questions.q: AW Computing (AWC) occasionally works with independent contractors, who the company stores as Contacts in Salesforce. Contractors often change agencies, and AWC wants to maintain the historical accuracy of the record. What should AWC use to track Contacts?
o: Enable Contacts to multiple Accounts.
Create a junction object to track many-to-many relationship.
Use a partner community to track the Contacts.
Create a new Contact record for each agency.
questions.e: "Contacts to Multiple Accounts" permite relacionar un contacto con varias cuentas (contratistas).

questions.q: Ursa Major Solar has a path on Case. The company wants to require its users to follow the status values as they are on the path. Agents should be prohibited from reverting the Case back to a previous status. Which feature should an administrator use to fulfill this request?
o: Validation Rules
Global Value Picklists
Predefined Field Values
Dependent Picklists
questions.e: Impedir retroceder estados de un path se hace con una validación que compare el valor anterior (PRIORVALUE).

questions.q: Users at Cloud Kicks want to be able to create a task that will repeat every two weeks. What should an administrator do to meet this requirement?
o: Turn on Recurring Activities
Flow to create recurring tasks
Workflow rule to create recurring tasks
Enable Creation of Recurring Tasks
questions.e: Crear tareas recurrentes exige activar "Enable Creation of Recurring Tasks" en la configuración de actividades.

questions.q: An administrator is on a tight deadline to create dashboards for the sales and marketing teams at AW Computing. What should the administrator do to meet the deadline without increasing the budget?
o: Build the dashboards manually to meet the deadline.
Check the AppExchange for a prebuilt solution that can be easily customized.
Train someone on the sales and marketing teams to build dashboards.
Hire a consultant to build the custom dashboards.
questions.e: Con poco tiempo, lo más eficaz es partir de una solución preconstruida de AppExchange y personalizarla.

questions.q: Users at Cloud Kicks are reporting different options when updating a custom picklist on the Opportunity object based on the kind of opportunity. Where should an administrator update the option in the picklist?
o: Fields and relationships
Record type
Picklist value sets
Related lookup filters
questions.e: Los record types muestran valores de picklist distintos según el tipo de oportunidad.

questions.q: The Support team at Ursa Major Solar occasionally views shipments from an application external to Salesforce. What is the best way to configure the UI to allow for this functionality?
o: Filter by a single shipment record type in the list view.
Use external objects and add a custom tab to the Support App for support agents.
Split views are only available on standard objects.
Add the Manage List Views permission for support users.
questions.e: Los objetos externos (Salesforce Connect) muestran datos de un sistema externo sin copiarlos; se añade una pestaña personalizada.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks has a custom object called Shipments. The company wants to see all the shipment items from an Account page. When an Account is deleted, the shipments should remain. What type of relationship should the administrator make between Shipments and Accounts?
o: Accounts should have a lookup to Shipments.
Shipments should have a master detail to Accounts.
Accounts should have a master detail to Shipments.
Shipments should have a lookup to Account.
questions.e: Para que los envíos sobrevivan al borrado de la cuenta se usa lookup (con master-detail se borrarían en cascada).

questions.q: An analytics user at Cloud Kicks needs Read, Create, and Edit access for objects and should be restricted from deleting any records. What should the administrator do to meet this requirement?
o: Create and assign a custom profile with Delete access removed for each object.
Create and assign a permission set that includes Read, Create, and Edit access.
Give the user View All access and assign them to the highest role in the role hierarchy.
Assign the standard System Administrator profile to the analytics user.
questions.e: Un perfil personalizado sin el permiso Delete en los objetos cumple el requisito; los perfiles estándar no se pueden editar.

questions.q: An administrator at DreamHouse Realty wants an easier way to assign cases based on agent capacity and skill set. Which feature should the administrator enable to meet this requirement?
o: Territory Management
Escalation Rules
Knowledge Management
Omni-Channel
questions.e: Omni-Channel enruta trabajo según capacidad y habilidades de los agentes.

questions.q: A sales rep at Ursa Major Solar has launched a series of networking events. They are hosting one event per month and want to be able to report on Campaign ROI by month and series. How should the administrator set up the Campaign to simplify reporting?
o: Create individual Campaigns that all have the same name.
Configure Campaign Member Statuses to record which event Members attended.
Use Campaign Hierarchy where the monthly events roll up to a parent Campaign.
Add different record types for the monthly event types.
questions.e: Los Campaign Member Statuses registran a qué evento asistió cada miembro, base para el ROI por campaña.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks users are seeing error messages when they use one of their screen flows. The error messages are confusing but could be resolved if the users entered more information on the account before starting the flow. How should the administrator address this issue?
o: Uncheck the End User Flow Errors box in Setup.
Create a permission set to allow users to bypass the error.
Use a fault connector and display a screen with text explaining what went wrong and how to correct it.
Remove validation rules so that the users are able to proceed without complete records.
questions.e: Un fault connector lleva a una pantalla con texto claro para el usuario cuando falla un elemento.

questions.q: The Ursa Major Solar administrator is editing the page layout for a new custom object. A text area field is accidentally removed from the page layout, and it needs to be restored to the page layout. Which are two methods for achieving this goal?
o: Restore from the recycle bin within 15 days.
Clone the layout from a different profile and use save as.
From the fields palette, drag the field into the same position.
Restore original page layout from a sandbox.
questions.e: Se arrastra el campo desde la paleta o se restaura el layout original desde un sandbox.

questions.q: The marketing team at Ursa Major Solar wants to send a personalized email whenever a lead fills out the web-to-lead form on their website. They want to send different messages based on the Lead Industry field value. What should an administrator configure to meet this requirement?
o: Create an assignment rule to email the lead.
Add a public group and Process Builder to email the lead.
Configure an auto-response rule to email the lead.
Use a validation rule to trigger workflow to email the lead.
questions.e: Las reglas de auto-respuesta para web-to-lead envían un email al lead; con Lead Auto-Response Rules se personaliza por criterios.

questions.q: The administrator has created new users for ten new employees at Northern Trail Outfitters. Why are these users unable to view the account tab in the Salesforce org?
o: Users' profile requires permission to the Account object.
Organization-wide defaults are set to private.
Users' profile requires a sharing rule for Accounts.
Users' roles are low on the role hierarchy.
questions.e: Si no ven la pestaña Accounts es porque el perfil no tiene permiso sobre el objeto Cuenta.

questions.q: The call center manager at Ursa Major Solar wants to provide agents with a case dashboard that can be drilled down by case origin, status, and owner. What should an administrator add to the dashboard to fulfill the request?
o: Dashboard Filter
Bucket Column
Combination Chart
Dashboard Component
questions.e: Un filtro de dashboard (Dashboard Filter) permite desglosar por origen, estado o propietario.

questions.q: The administrator at Northern Trail Outfitters has been using a spreadsheet to track assigned licenses and permission sets. What feature can be used to track this in Salesforce?
o: Lightning Usage App
Permission Set Groups
Login History
User Report
questions.e: El User Report/informes de usuarios con licencias y permission sets sustituye al control en hoja de cálculo.

questions.q: Ursa Major Solar wants to automatically notify a manager about any cases awaiting a response from an agent for more than 2 hours after case creation. Which feature should an administrator use to fulfill this requirement?
o: Case Escalation Rule
Omni-Channel Supervisor
Assignment Rule
Formula field
questions.e: Las reglas de escalado notifican (o reasignan) casos sin respuesta pasadas las horas definidas.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants emails received from customers to generate cases automatically. How should the administrator ensure that the emails are sent to the correct queue?
o: Configure Email-to-Case so emails are delivered to the correct queue.
Create an Escalation Rule to send cases to the correct queue.
Utilize a flow to identify the correct queue and assign the case.
Use a custom email service to set the owner of the case upon creation.
questions.e: Email-to-Case convierte los correos en casos y los enruta a la cola correcta mediante las direcciones de enrutamiento.

questions.q: The sales director at Cloud Kicks wants to be able to predict upcoming revenue in the next several fiscal quarters so they can set goals and benchmark how reps are performing. Which two features should the administrator configure?
o: Opportunity Stages
Sales Quotas
Forecasting
Opportunity List View
questions.e: Forecasting más Sales Quotas permiten predecir ingresos por trimestre y comparar con objetivos.

questions.q: An administrator at Universal Containers has been asked to prevent some users from accessing Salesforce from outside of their network. What are two considerations for this configuration?
o: Assign single sign-on to a permission set to allow users to log in when outside the network.
Enforce Login IP Ranges on Every Request on the profile must be selected to enforce IP restrictions.
Restrict U2F Security Keys on the user's profile to enforce login hours.
IP address restrictions are set on the profile for the org.
questions.e: Las restricciones por IP del perfil requieren activar "Enforce login IP ranges on every request" para aplicar a todas las peticiones.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks needs to change the owner of a case when it has been open for more than 7 days. How should the administrator complete this requirement?
o: Auto-Response Rules
Validation Rules
Assignment Rules
Escalation Rules
questions.e: Una regla de escalado puede cambiar el propietario de un caso abierto más de 7 días.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters has a custom quick action on Account that creates a new Case. How should an administrator make the quick action available on the Salesforce mobile app?
o: Include the action in the Salesforce Mobile Navigation menu.
Modify compact Case page layout to include the action.
Add the Salesforce Mobile and Lightning Experience action to the page layout.
Create a custom Lightning App with the action.
questions.e: La acción personalizada debe añadirse al layout en la sección "Salesforce Mobile and Lightning Experience Actions".

questions.q: The administrator at Ursa Major Solar has created a custom report type and built a report for the sales operations team. However, none of the users are able to access the report. Which two options could cause this issue?
o: The user's profile is missing View access.
The org has reached its limit for custom report types.
The report is saved in a private folder.
The custom report type is in development.
questions.e: Si nadie ve el informe: está en una carpeta privada o falta acceso al tipo de informe/carpeta en su perfil.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks wants to track shoe designs by products because there can be multiple designs for one product across various stages. They need to know how many designs have been created for a given product on the product record. Which two steps should the administrator configure to meet this requirement?
o: Use the standard object for designs.
Configure a custom lookup field for shoe designs on the Product object.
Create a custom object for shoe designs.
Add a custom master-detail field for shoe designs on the Design object.
questions.e: Un objeto personalizado para los diseños con un campo master-detail hacia Producto permite resumir diseños por producto.

questions.q: The administrator at Universal Containers has a screen flow that helps users create new leads. When Lead Source is "Search Engine", the administrator needs to require the user to choose a specific search engine from a picklist. If Lead Source is not "Search Engine", this picklist should be hidden. What is the most efficient way for the administrator to complete this requirement?
o: Use a conditional filter in the screen element to only show 'Specific Search Engine' field only when Lead Source is "Search Engine".
Configure a picklist for Specific Search Engine, and use a validation rule to conditionally show only when Lead Source is "Search Engine".
Create a picklist for Specific Search Engine, and set conditional visibility so that it is only shown when Lead Source is "Search Engine".
Use an assignment element, one for when Lead Source is "Search Engine" and one for everything else.
questions.e: Para mostrar un campo solo con cierto valor se usa visibilidad condicional en el componente de pantalla.

questions.q: What should an administrator use as an identifier when importing and updating records from a separate financial system?
o: Rich Text field
Auto-Number field
External ID
Record ID
questions.e: El campo External ID sirve como identificador al importar/actualizar (upsert) desde otro sistema.

questions.q: The business development team at Cloud Kicks thinks the Account creation process has too many fields to fill out and the page feels cluttered. They have requested the administrator to simplify the process. Which automation tool should an administrator use?
o: Workflow Rule
Flow Builder
Validation Rule
Approval Process
questions.e: Simplificar la creación de cuentas con pasos guiados se resuelve con un screen flow.

questions.q: Sales managers would like to know what could be implemented to surface important values based on the stage of the opportunity. Which tool should an administrator use to meet this requirement?
o: Workflow Rules
Dynamic Forms
Path Key Fields
Opportunity Processes
questions.e: Los Key Fields de Path muestran campos importantes en cada etapa de la oportunidad.

questions.q: A team of support users at Cloud Kicks is helping inside sales reps make follow-up calls to prospects that filled out an interest form online. The team currently does not have access to the Lead object. How should an administrator provide proper access?
o: Set up Manual sharing
Create a new profile
Assign a new role
Configure permission sets
questions.e: Las permission sets añaden permisos puntuales a usuarios sin cambiar su perfil.

questions.q: An administrator supporting a global team of Salesforce users has been asked to configure company settings. Which two options should the administrator configure?
o: Currency Locale
Password Policy
Login Hours
Default Language
questions.e: En la configuración de empresa se definen idioma predeterminado y configuración regional/moneda.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks has a customer success agent going on leave and needs to change ownership on multiple cases. Which two users are able to fulfill this request?
o: A user with the System Administrator profile.
A user with the Manage Cases permission.
A user with Read permission on the account.
A user with a manager role above the agent.
questions.e: Cambian propietarios de casos el administrador o un usuario con el permiso Manage Cases.

questions.q: Ursa Major Solar classifies its accounts as Silver, Gold, or Platinum Level. When a new case is created for a Silver or Gold partner, it should go to the Regular Support Queue. When an account is Platinum Level, it should automatically go to the Priority Support Queue. What should the administrator use to achieve this?
o: Escalation Rules
Workflow Rules
Case Rules
Assignment Rules
questions.e: Las reglas de asignación de casos usan criterios (nivel de cuenta) para dirigir a cada cola.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks is working on a better way to track its product shipments utilizing Salesforce. Which field type should an administrator use to capture coordinates?
o: Geolocation
Geofence
Custom address
External lookup
questions.e: El campo Geolocation guarda latitud y longitud.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) has deployed My Domain. The Chief Marketing Officer wants to make sure that all of the Salesforce users log in using the branded login URL. There needs to be a grace period for the users' bookmarks to be updated. How should the administrator configure the policies in My Domain settings?
o: Set the redirect policy to Redirect with a warning to the same page within the domain.
Set the login policy to prevent login from https://login.salesforce.com
Set the login policy to require login from https://nto.my.salesforce.com
Set the Redirect policy to Do Not redirect.
questions.e: Con My Domain, la política "Redirect with a warning to the same page within the domain" lleva a la URL con marca.

questions.q: Universal Containers created a new job posting on the first of the month. It triggered a process scheduled action that will send a Chatter post to the department VP in 30 days if the position is still open and the status is not equal to Interviewing. On the 10th of the month, an applicant interviews, and the job posting status is updated to Interviewing. What will happen to the Chatter post in this situation?
o: The pending Chatter post will be sent in 30 days.
The pending Chatter post will be canceled.
The pending Chatter post will be paused.
The pending Chatter post will be sent on the 10th of the month.
questions.e: Una acción programada de un proceso queda pendiente y se ejecuta en el momento indicado (30 días).

questions.q: Sales reps miss key fields when filling out an opportunity record through the sales process. Reps need to move forward in stages but are unable to enter a previous stage. Which three options should the administrator use to address this need?
o: Use Flow to mark fields required.
Mark fields required on the page layout.
Use validation rules.
Enable guided selling.
Configure Opportunity Path.
questions.e: Combinar campos obligatorios en layout, validaciones y Opportunity Path obliga a completar datos al avanzar de etapa.

questions.q: Which two solutions could an administrator find on the AppExchange to enhance their organization?
o: Consultants
Communities
Customers
Components
questions.e: En AppExchange se encuentran consultores y componentes (apps, Lightning components).

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to update data with information from their data warehouse. What should an administrator do to accomplish this?
o: Use an external ID field to match records between the systems.
Use the data loader to match records between the systems.
Use an external object to match records between the systems.
Use a unique ID field to match records between the systems.
questions.e: Los objetos externos/Salesforce Connect enlazan datos del almacén externo sin duplicarlos.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks has the organization-wide defaults for Opportunity set to Private. Which two features should the administrator use to open up access to opportunity records for sales users working on collaborative deals?
o: Sharing set
Role hierarchy
Profiles
Sharing rules
questions.e: Con OWD privado se abre acceso con jerarquía de roles y reglas de uso compartido.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters has hired interns to enter Leads into Salesforce and has requested a way to identify these new records from existing Leads. What approach should an administrator take to meet this requirement?
o: Create a separate Lead Lightning App.
Define a record type and assign it to the interns.
Update the active Lead Assignment Rules.
Set up Web-to-Lead for the interns' use.
questions.e: Un record type asignado a los becarios permite identificar y distinguir los leads que ellos crean.

questions.q: At Universal Containers, users would like to be able to share Salesforce records with other members of their team, while collaborating around general topics as well. Which are two considerations for enabling this functionality?
o: Collaboration groups are created automatically for every department.
The Add Record action must be configured in the group publisher.
An administrator needs to create a group to enable record sharing.
Object layouts should be configured to include the groups related list.
questions.e: Para compartir registros en un grupo hay que crear el grupo y configurar la acción Add Record en el publisher del grupo.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks wants users to only be able to choose Opportunity stage closed won if the Lead source has been selected. How should the administrator accomplish this goal?
o: Change the Opportunity stage field to read only on the page layout.
Configure a validation rule requiring Lead source when the stage is set to closed won.
Modify the Opportunity stage a dependent picklist to the Lead source field.
Make Lead source a dependent picklist to the Opportunity stage field.
questions.e: Una regla de validación exige Lead Source cuando la etapa es Closed Won.

questions.q: An administrator has been asked to change the data type of an auto number to a text field. What should the administrator be aware of before changing the field?
o: Existing Auto Number field to Text is prevented.
Existing field values will be converted.
Existing field values will be deleted.
Existing field values will remain unchanged.
questions.e: Al convertir un Auto Number a Texto, los valores existentes se conservan.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks has the organization-wide sharing default set to private on the Shoe object. The sales manager should be able to view a report containing shoe records for all of the sales reps on their team. Which three items should the administrator configure to provide appropriate access to the report?
o: Field-Level Security
Report Subscription
Role Hierarchy
Folder Access
Custom Report Type
questions.e: Para ver informes de registros con OWD privado el manager necesita la jerarquía de roles, acceso a la carpeta y visibilidad de los campos (FLS).

questions.q: DreamHouse Realty has an approval process. A manager attempts to approve the record but receives an error. What should the administrator review to troubleshoot this request?
o: Review the page layout to ensure the fields updated in the process are visible.
Add a delegated approver for the next approver in the process.
Check if the user in the next approver is inactive or missing.
Update the field-level security to view on fields that are updated in the process.
questions.e: Si el aprobador siguiente está inactivo o no existe, la aprobación falla; es lo primero a revisar.

questions.q: A user at Northern Trail Outfitters is having trouble logging into Salesforce. The user's login history shows that this person has attempted to log in multiple times and has been locked out of the organization. Which two ways should the administrator help the user log into Salesforce?
o: Use the unlock button on the user's record detail page.
Log in as the user to unlock the user and reset the password.
Reset password on the user's record detail page.
Reset the password policies to allow the user to login.
questions.e: Un usuario bloqueado se desbloquea con el botón Unlock en su registro; también se puede restablecer la contraseña.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to use Contact Hierarchy in its org to display Contact association. What should the administrator take into consideration regarding the Contact Hierarchy?
o: Contacts displayed in the Contact Hierarchy are limited to record-level access by user.
Customizing hierarchy columns changes the Recently Viewed Contacts list view.
Contact Hierarchy is limited to only display 3,000 contacts at one time.
Sharing settings are ignored by contacts displayed in the Contact Hierarchy.
questions.e: La jerarquía de contactos solo muestra los contactos a los que el usuario tiene acceso a nivel de registro.

questions.q: AW Computing needs to capture a loss reason in a rich text field when an opportunity is closed lost. How should an administrator configure this requirement?
o: Check the required checkbox on the Loss Reason field in Object Manager.
Select the required checkbox next to the Loss Reason field on the page layout.
Configure a workflow rule to display an error if Loss Reason is blank.
Create a validation rule to display an error if stage is closed lost and Loss Reason is blank.
questions.e: Hacer obligatorio un campo al cerrar como perdida se resuelve con una validación que se dispara cuando la etapa es Closed Lost.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks is working on a rebrand. In which two areas of the Salesforce mobile app can the administrator customize the branding?
o: Popups header color
Record background color
Header background color
Loading page logo
questions.e: En la app móvil se personalizan el color de la cabecera y el logo de la pantalla de carga.

questions.q: Ursa Major Solar has its business hours set from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM for the reps that are on Pacific Time. The reps on Eastern Time need business hours set to start 3 hours earlier to cover for support. How should an administrator solve for this issue?
o: Create one set of business hours per time zone.
Set temporary business hours for each time zone.
Allow the reps to set business hours manually.
Adjust the current business hours to accommodate the Eastern Time Zone.
questions.e: Se define un conjunto de horarios laborales por zona horaria.

questions.q: Universal Containers has a Contact Lightning record page with a component that shows LinkedIn data. The sales team would like to only show this component to those users who have the Sales User profile when they are on their mobile phones. Which two solutions should the administrator use to fulfill this requirement?
o: Filter the component visibility with User > Role > Name = Sales User.
Filter the component visibility with View = Mobile/Tablet.
Filter the component visibility with Form Factor = Phone.
Filter the component visibility with User > Profile > Name = Sales User.
questions.e: La visibilidad del componente se filtra por perfil de usuario y por factor de forma del dispositivo.

questions.q: An administrator wants to create a form in Salesforce for users to fill out when they lose a client. Which automation tool supports creating a wizard to accomplish this goal?
o: Outbound Message
Approval Process
Flow Builder
Process Builder
questions.e: Un asistente (wizard) de varias pantallas se construye con un screen flow.

questions.q: Sales users at Cloud Kicks are requesting that the data in the Industry field on the Account object displays on the Opportunity page layout. Which type of field should an administrator create to accomplish this?
o: Custom Account field
Master-detail relationship field
Cross-object formula field
Standard Account field
questions.e: Un campo fórmula entre objetos (cross-object) muestra el valor del campo de la cuenta en la oportunidad.

questions.q: Support reps at Cloud Kicks (CK) are reporting that when they try to close a case, the Closed option in the Case Status picklist is missing. CK has asked the administrator to find a solution. Why are the support reps unable to see the Closed option in the specified picklist?
o: The Show Closed Statuses in Case Status Field checkbox is set to the default.
The Support Process being used omits Closed as a status choice.
The Case record type is missing Closed as a picklist value.
The Close Case page layout must be used to close a case.
questions.e: Si falta el valor Closed en el Status, el record type del caso no lo tiene entre los valores permitidos.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters has a new flow that automatically sets field values when a new account is created. The flow is launched by a process, but the flow is not working properly. What should the administrator do to identify the problem?
o: View the setup audit trail and review for errors.
Set up email logs and review the send error logs.
Use the native debug feature in the Flow Builder.
Review debug logs with the flow logging level.
questions.e: Se depura el flow con la función de depuración nativa de Flow Builder.

questions.q: Which tool should an administrator use to identify and fix potential session vulnerabilities?
o: Field History Tracking
Setup Audit Trail
Organization-Wide Defaults
Security Health Check
questions.e: Security Health Check detecta y corrige configuraciones de sesión y seguridad poco seguras.

questions.q: An administrator at Cloud Kicks has a flow in production that is supposed to create new records. However, no new records are being created. What could the issue be?
o: The flow url is deactivated.
The flow is inactive.
The flow trigger is missing.
The flow is read only.
questions.e: Si un flow no crea registros, lo más probable es que esté inactivo (no activado).

questions.q: Cloud Kicks (CK) is partnering with a used shoe store and second-hand bicycle emporium. CK has an automated business process it wants to run once a week to count the number of open cases related to an account. How should the administrator recommend automating this business process?
o: Create a workflow rule with an outbound message.
Configure a scheduled flow in Flow Builder.
Use a process to update the account when it is edited.
Set up a scheduled process in Process Builder.
questions.e: Un proceso semanal sin intervención de usuario es un scheduled flow.

questions.q: The administrator at Cloud Kicks has a custom picklist field on Lead, which is missing on the Contact when leads are converted. Which two items should the administrator do to make sure these values are populated?
o: Create a custom picklist field on Contact.
Set the picklist field to be required on the Lead object.
Map the picklist field on the Lead to the Contact.
Update the picklist value with a validation rule.
questions.e: Hay que crear el campo en Contacto y mapear el campo del Lead al del Contacto.

questions.q: An administrator at Cloud Kicks is building a flow that needs to search for records that meet certain conditions and store values from those records in variables for use later in the flow. What flow element should the administrator add?
o: Get Records
Update Records
Assignment
Create Records
questions.e: El elemento Get Records busca registros con condiciones y guarda sus valores en variables.

questions.q: Which two objects are customizable in the Stage Setup Flow?
o: Campaign Members
Leads
Campaigns
Opportunities
questions.e: El Stage Setup Flow permite personalizar los objetos Lead y Oportunidad.

questions.q: An administrator at Universal Containers needs a simple way to trigger an alert to the director of sales when opportunities reach an amount of $500,000. What should the administrator configure to meet this requirement?
o: Key Deals component on the homepage
Opportunity warnings in Kanban View
Enable Opportunity Update Reminders.
Set up Big Deal Alerts for the amount.
questions.e: Big Deal Alerts envía una alerta automática al alcanzar el importe definido.

questions.q: An administrator installed a managed package that contains a permission set group. The permission set group that was installed includes Delete access on several objects, and the administrator needs to prevent users in the permission set group from being able to delete records. What should the administrator do to control Delete access?
o: Use a muting permission set with a permission set group to mute selected permissions.
Create a new permission set that has Delete access deselected for the objects.
Edit the profile for the users to remove Delete access from the objects.
Create a new role that prevents Delete permissions from rolling up to the users.
questions.e: Un permission set de silenciado (muting) dentro del grupo desactiva permisos concretos del grupo instalado.

questions.q: The sales manager at DreamHouse Realty wants the sales users to have a quick way to view and edit the Opportunities in their pipeline expected to close in the next 90 days. What should an administrator do to accomplish this request?
o: Make a new Sales dashboard and add a component that shows all opportunities that meet the criteria.
Create a custom report and schedule the sales users to receive it each day as a reminder to update their opportunities.
Create a list view on the Opportunity object and recommend users switch the view to Kanban to edit by drag and drop.
Enable Sales Console and show users how to open a tab for each opportunity in the pipeline that meets the requirements.
questions.e: Sales Console con pestañas por oportunidad permite ver y editar rápidamente el pipeline.

questions.q: An administrator at Universal Containers needs an automated way to delete records based on field values. What automated solution should the administrator use?
o: Workflow
Automation Studio
Flow Builder
Process Builder
questions.e: Eliminar registros por valores de campo automáticamente se hace con un flow.

questions.q: An administrator at Cloud Kicks needs to export a file of closed won opportunities from the last 90 days. The file should include the Opportunity Name, ID, Close Date, and Amount. How should the administrator export this file?
o: Data Loader
Data Export Service
Data Export wizard
Data Import Wizard
questions.e: Data Loader exporta registros con consulta (SOQL) filtrando por fecha y etapa.

questions.q: An administrator has reviewed an upcoming critical update. How should the administrator proceed with activation of the critical update?
o: Allow the critical update to auto-activate.
Activate the critical update in a sandbox.
Allow the critical update to auto-activate in a sandbox.
Activate the critical update in production.
questions.e: Las actualizaciones críticas se prueban primero en un sandbox antes de activarlas en producción.

questions.q: Universal Containers' administrator has been asked to create a many-to-many relationship between two existing custom objects. Which two steps should the administrator take when enabling the many-to-many relationship?
o: Create two lookup relationships on the new object.
Create a junction object with a custom object.
Create URL fields on a custom object.
Create two master-detail relationships on the new object.
questions.e: Una relación muchos a muchos se modela con un objeto de unión y dos relaciones master-detail.

questions.q: Once an opportunity reaches the negotiation stage at Cloud Kicks, the Amount field becomes required for sales users. Sales managers need to be able to move opportunities into this stage without knowing the amount. How should the administrator require this field during the negotiation stage for sales users but allow their managers to make changes?
o: Make the field required for all users.
Configure a validation rule to meet the criteria.
Create a formula field to fill in the field for managers.
Assign the Administrator profile to the managers.
questions.e: Un campo obligatorio a nivel de objeto/layout afecta a todos los usuarios, sin excepciones.
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar (lo habitual sería una regla de validación).

questions.q: The client services and customer support teams share the same profile but have different permission sets. The custom object Retention related list needs to be restricted to the client services team on the Lightning record page layout. What should the administrator use to fulfill this request?
o: Page Layout Assignment
Component Visibility
Record Type Assignment
Sharing Settings
questions.e: La visibilidad del componente permite mostrar la lista relacionada solo a quien tenga cierto permiso.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters uses a custom object Invoice to collect customer payment information from an external billing system. The Billing System field needs to be filled in on every Invoice record. How should an administrator ensure this requirement?
o: Define an approval process for the field.
Make the field universally required.
Create a Process Builder to set the field.
Require the field on the record type.
questions.e: Rellenar un campo automáticamente al crear un registro se hace con una automatización (Process Builder/flow).

questions.q: Users at Cloud Kicks want to see information more useful for their role on the Case page. How should an administrator make the pages more dynamic and easier to use?
o: Delete the extra components from the page.
Add component visibility filters to the components.
Include more tab components with filters.
Remove fields from the record details component.
questions.e: Los filtros de visibilidad de componentes hacen la página más dinámica según el rol.

questions.q: An administrator wants to trigger a follow-up task for the opportunity owner when they close an opportunity as won, and another task after 60 days to check in with the customer. Which automation tool should the administrator use?
o: Assignment Rule
Field Update
Outbound Message
Flow Builder
questions.e: Crear tareas inmediatas y otra a 60 días se resuelve con un flow con ruta programada.

questions.q: A sales rep has left the company and an administrator has been asked to re-assign all their accounts and opportunities to a new sales rep and keep the teams as is. Which tool should an administrator use to accomplish this?
o: Data Import Wizard
Mass Transfer Tool
Dataloader.io
Data Loader
questions.e: La herramienta Mass Transfer reasigna en bloque cuentas y oportunidades y puede mantener los equipos.

questions.q: The administrator at Cloud Kicks created a new field for tracking returns on their new cloud shoe. A user has submitted a case to the administrator indicating that the new field is unavailable. Which two steps should an administrator do to troubleshoot this issue?
o: Review the field-level security of the field for the user profile.
Update the organization-wide defaults for the object.
Run the setup audit trail for the organization.
Ensure that the page layout for the user's profile has been updated.
questions.e: Si el usuario no ve el campo nuevo, revisa la seguridad a nivel de campo y que el layout del perfil lo incluya.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks' executives have noticed the Opportunity Expected Revenue field displays incorrect values. How should the administrator correct this?
o: Update the expected revenue associated with the stage.
Adjust the forecast category associated with the stage.
Change the probability associated with the stage.
Modify the closed won value associated with the stage.
questions.e: Ingresos esperados = importe × probabilidad; para corregirlos se cambia la probabilidad de la etapa.

questions.q: AW Computing has six sales teams in a region. These teams always consist of the same account manager, engineer, and assistant. What should the administrator configure to make it easier for teams to collaborate with the same customer?
o: Create a queue for each team and assign account ownership to the queue.
Enable account teams and show the users how to set up a default account team.
Propose the users manually share all their accounts with their teammates.
Enable and configure standard opportunity teams with splits.
questions.e: Los equipos de cuenta (Account Teams) con un equipo predeterminado repiten siempre la misma composición.

questions.q: Management at Universal Containers would like to share dashboard components with their team in Chatter but currently do not have access to this capability. How should the administrator make this functionality available to management?
o: Select Download Chart on the component.
Set View Dashboard As to the dashboard viewer.
Enable reporting snapshots.
Enable dashboard feed tracking.
questions.e: Habilitando el seguimiento del feed en dashboards se comparten componentes en Chatter.

questions.q: The administrator at Cloud Kicks updated the custom object Event to include a lookup field to the primary contact for the event. When running an event report, they want to reference fields from the associated contact record. What should the administrator do to pull contact fields into the custom report?
o: Configure formula fields on Event to populate contact information.
Use a dashboard with filters to show Event and contact data as requested.
Edit the custom Event report type and add fields related via lookup.
Create a new report type with Event as the primary object and Contact as a related object.
questions.e: Un tipo de informe personalizado con Evento como objeto primario y Contacto como secundario permite informar del lookup.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks generates leads for its different product categories (shoes, apparel, and accessories) through many different sources. While some lead sources are used for all three categories, other lead sources are specific to a single category. The VP of marketing requests that only the proper lead sources be displayed based on the product category chosen. How should the administrator configure Salesforce to meet this requirement?
o: Create business processes and record types for each of the three product categories.
Create a single lead process, then create record types for each product category.
Create a page layout for each category and filter the Lead Source field based on category.
Create a dependency between the Product Category field and Lead Source field.
questions.e: Business processes y record types por categoría limitan los orígenes de lead disponibles.
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar.

questions.q: The CTO of AW Computing has defined a new policy for cases to improve customer satisfaction. All cases submitted with a Case Reason of Installation must be acknowledged immediately via email and assigned to the appropriate agents. Any cases that are still in the New status after 4 hours must be escalated to support management. What case management tools need to be utilized for this requirement?
o: Auto-response rules, Support Processes, Entitlements
Auto-response rules, Entitlements, Queues
Auto-response rules, Support Processes, Escalation Rules
Auto-response rules, Queues, formulas
questions.e: Auto-response, entitlements y colas combinados cubren el reconocimiento de casos en un plazo concreto.
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar.

questions.q: What data loss considerations should an administrator keep in mind when changing a custom field type from Text to Picklist?
o: Assignment and escalation rules may be affected.
There will be no data loss with use of a global value set.
Any list view based on the custom field is deleted.
Auto updates will be made to Visualforce references to prevent data loss.
questions.e: Cambiar Text a Picklist puede afectar a reglas de asignación/escalado; con global value set no hay pérdida de datos.
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters uses web-to-case to convert support requests submitted through its website into cases. The support team wants to automatically send an email containing password reset instructions to the customers when the case subject contains the words forgot and password. What two options should the administrator configure to meet this requirement?
o: Password reset template
Email-to-case
Email template
Auto-response rule
questions.e: Una plantilla de email más una regla de auto-respuesta confirman automáticamente la recepción del caso.

questions.q: What are three characteristics of a master-detail relationship?
o: Permissions for the detail record are set independently of the master.
Each object can have up to five master-detail relationships.
The owner field on the detail records is the owner of the master record.
The master object can be a standard or custom object.
Roll-up summaries are supported in master-detail relationships.
questions.e: En master-detail el propietario del detalle es el del maestro y se admiten roll-up summaries; el maestro puede ser estándar o personalizado.

questions.q: The administrator at Cloud Kicks has created an approval process for time off requests. Which two automated actions are available to be added as part of the approval process?
o: Autolaunched Flow
Email Alert
Chatter Post
Field Update
questions.e: Las acciones automáticas de una aprobación incluyen alertas de email y actualización de campos.
questions.note: La captura muestra tres opciones marcadas (B, C, D) aunque el enunciado pide dos; se ha dejado B y D (Email Alert y Field Update) y conviene revisarla.

questions.q: Universal Containers (UC) customers have provided feedback that their support cases are not being responded to quickly enough. UC wants to send all unassigned Cases that have been open for more than 2 hours to an urgent Case queue and alert the support manager. Which feature should an administrator configure to meet this requirement?
o: Case Assignment Rules
Case Escalation Rules
Case Dashboard Refreshes
Case Scheduled Reports
questions.e: Las reglas de escalado envían casos sin asignar a otra cola o usuario pasado un tiempo.

questions.q: An administrator has assigned a permission set group with the two-factor authentication for User Interface Logins permission and the two-factor authentication for API Logins permission to a group of users. Which two prompts will happen when one of the users attempts to log in to Data Loader?
o: Users need to enter a verification code from email or SMS, whichever has higher priority.
Users need to connect an authenticator app to their Salesforce account.
Users need to download and install an authenticator app on their mobile device.
Users need to get a security token from a trusted network using Reset My Security Token.
questions.e: Con 2FA los usuarios deben instalar y conectar una app autenticadora.

questions.q: Ursa Major Solar offers amazing experiences for all of its employees. The employee engagement committee wants to post updates while restricting other employees from posting. What should the administrator create to meet this request?
o: Chatter Stream
Chatter Recommendations
Chatter Unlisted Group
Chatter Broadcast Group
questions.e: Un grupo de difusión (Broadcast Group) permite publicar a ciertos usuarios y que los demás solo lean.

questions.q: At Universal Containers, there is a custom field on the Lead named Product Category. Management wants this information to be part of the Opportunity upon lead conversion. What action should the administrator take to satisfy the request?
o: Map the lead custom field to the product's product category field.
Create a custom field on the Opportunity and map the two fields.
Configure the product categories picklist field on the product.
Create a workflow to update Opportunity fields based on the lead.
questions.e: Se crea el campo en Oportunidad y se mapea al campo del Lead para que se copie en la conversión.

questions.q: AW Computing would like to improve its Case Lightning record page by including: a filtered component to display a message in bold font when a Case is saved as a critical record type, and a quick way to update the Account status from the Case layout. Which two components should an administrator use to satisfy these requests?
o: Related record
Rich text
Related list
Record detail
questions.e: Una página de caso con componentes filtrados incluye registros relacionados y texto enriquecido.

questions.q: An administrator creates a custom text area field on the Account object and adds it to the service team's page layout. The service team manager loves the addition of this field and wants it to appear in the highlights panel so that the service reps can quickly find it when on the Account page. How should the administrator accomplish this?
o: Create a new page layout and a new section titled highlights panel.
In the Account object manager, create a custom compact layout.
From the page layout editor, drag the field to the highlights panel.
Make the field required and move it to the top of the page.
questions.e: Un compact layout personalizado define los campos clave que ve el equipo en la cabecera/resumen del registro.

questions.q: Ursa Major Solar wants to assist users with a guided expense report process to simplify submissions, routing, and authorizations. Which two tools should an administrator use to build this solution?
o: Flow Builder
Quick action
Approval Process
Validation Rule
questions.e: Un proceso guiado se construye con Flow Builder y el enrutamiento/autorización con un Approval Process.

questions.q: Users have noticed that when they click on a report in a dashboard to view the report details, the values in the report are different from the values displayed on the dashboard. What are the two reasons this is likely to occur?
o: The running dashboard user and viewer have different permissions.
The dashboard needs to be refreshed.
The report needs to be refreshed.
The current user does not have access to the report folder.
questions.e: Las diferencias suelen deberse a que el usuario que ejecuta el dashboard tiene otros permisos o a que no está actualizado.

questions.q: The standard Lead Rating field has picklist values of Hot, Warm, and Cold. A list of new leads was imported without errors even though several records had the value of Unrated in the Rating field. How were these records added without error?
o: The Add to All Record Types checkbox was selected.
A global picklist value set was used to populate the picklist.
The Restricted picklist checkbox was unchecked.
Field-level security was set to Visible for all profiles.
questions.e: Si se importó un valor no listado sin error, la picklist no estaba marcada como "Restricted".

questions.q: Users at DreamHouse Realty are only allowed to see opportunities they own. Leadership wants an enterprise-wide dashboard of all open opportunities in the pipeline so that users can see how the company is performing at any point in time. How should an administrator create the dashboard without changing any sharing settings?
o: Create a dashboard with the running user set as someone who can see all opportunities.
Build individual dashboards for profiles that need to see the enterprise results.
Add a filter to the dashboard to filter the opportunities by owner role.
Update the dashboard folder settings to manager for the sales reps role.
questions.e: Con OWD privado, la visión global se logra con dashboards con "Run as" un usuario con acceso amplio (dashboards dinámicos o de usuario concreto).
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar (lo habitual sería un usuario de ejecución con visibilidad total).

questions.q: DreamHouse Realty (DHR) wants a templated process with a mortgage calculator that generates leads for loans. DHR needs to complete the project within 30 days and has maxed out its budget for the year. Which AppExchange item should help the administrator meet the request?
o: Lightning Data
Lightning Community
Flow Solutions
Bolt Solutions
questions.e: Flow Solutions aportan procesos prediseñados listos para instalar y adaptar con poco tiempo.

questions.q: The VP of sales at Cloud Kicks has a standard sales profile and is receiving an error message that prevents them from saving an opportunity. The administrator attempted the same edit without receiving an error. How can the administrator troubleshoot this issue?
o: Ask the user for their password so the admin can log in as the user.
Use an AppExchange product to troubleshoot.
Use 'Login as' to log in as the user.
Log in as a system administrator to troubleshoot.
questions.e: "Login as" permite reproducir el error exactamente con la configuración del usuario.

questions.q: Which two actions should an administrator perform with Case escalation rules?
o: Send email notifications.
Change the Case Priority.
Re-open the Case.
Re-assign the Case.
questions.e: Una regla de escalado puede enviar notificaciones por email y reasignar el caso.

questions.q: The marketing director at Northern Trail Outfitters has requested that the Budget field is populated in order for the Lead Status field to be marked as qualified. What tool should the administrator use to fulfill this request?
o: Workflow Rule
Validation Rule
Require Field
Lead Conversion
questions.e: Exigir un campo según el valor de otro es un caso típico de validation rule.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks wants its reports to show a Fiscal Year that starts on February 1 and has 12 months. How should the administrator address this requirement?
o: Set the Fiscal Year to Standard and the duration to 12 months.
Set the Fiscal Year to Standard and the starting month as February.
Set the Fiscal Year to Custom and the starting month as February.
Set the Fiscal Year to Custom and the duration to 4 quarters.
questions.e: Año fiscal estándar con mes de inicio febrero cubre los 12 meses desde el 1 de febrero.
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar.

questions.q: Universal Containers requires a different Lightning page to be displayed when Accounts are viewed in the Sales Console and in the Service Console. How should an administrator meet this requirement?
o: Create different user profiles.
Assign Lightning pages as app default.
Update page layout assignments.
Define multiple record types.
questions.e: Las asignaciones de página (App, record type, perfil) deciden qué Lightning page se ve en cada consola.
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar.

questions.q: When users log in to Salesforce via the user interface, which two settings does the system check for authentication?
o: The user's Two-Factor Authentication for User Interface Logins permission
The user's Two-Factor Authentication for API Logins permission
The user's profile login hours restrictions
The role IP address restrictions
questions.e: En el login por UI se comprueban, entre otros, restricciones de horario del perfil y requisitos de 2FA.
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar (parece incorrecta: lo esperable sería A y C).

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters has the Case object set to private. The support manager raised a concern that reps have a broader view of data than expected and can see all cases on their group's dashboards. What could be causing reps to have inappropriate access to data on dashboards?
o: Dashboard's running user
Public Dashboards
Dashboard Subscriptions
Dashboard Filters
questions.e: Los dashboards públicos pueden mostrar datos de todos los casos a quien tiene acceso al dashboard.
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar (lo habitual es el usuario de ejecución del dashboard).

questions.q: The administrator at AW Computing wants Account details, related lists, and Chatter feeds to each appear on separate tabs when viewing an Account. Which type of page should the administrator create?
o: Lightning home page
Lightning app page
Lightning page component
Lightning record page
questions.e: Una Lightning record page con pestañas separa detalles, listas relacionadas y Chatter.

questions.q: Ursa Major Solar provides a 1-year warranty on all of the panels it installs. Installation details, along with the warranty information, are captured on a custom object called Installation. The installation record is created by the installer from the mobile app. Customers sometimes receive a longer warranty as a way of increasing customer satisfaction when an installation gets delayed or has issues. How should the administrator configure Salesforce to capture the expiration date of the warranty?
o: Add a validation rule to ensure the Expiration Date field is populated.
Use a formula as the default value of the warranty Expiration Date field.
Include the warranty Expiration Date field on the mobile page layout.
Create a formula field to display 1 year from the warranty purchased.
questions.e: Un campo fórmula calcula la fecha de fin de garantía (compra + 1 año).
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to encourage employees to choose secure and appropriate passwords for their Salesforce accounts. Which three password policies should an administrator configure?
o: Number of days until expiration
Maximum invalid login attempts
Require use of Password Manager App
Prohibited password values
Password complexity requirements
questions.e: Las políticas incluyen caducidad, intentos fallidos máximos y requisitos de complejidad.
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar.

questions.q: The administrator at Ursa Major Solar imported records into an object by mistake. Which two tools should be used to undo this import?
o: Data Import Wizard
Weekly Data Export
Data Loader
Mass Delete Records
questions.e: Se deshace una importación con Mass Delete Records o Data Loader eliminando los registros importados.

questions.q: Universal Containers has a private sharing model for Opportunities and uses Opportunity teams. Criteria-based sharing rules are not used. A sales rep at Universal Containers leaves the company and their user record is deactivated. The rep is later rehired in the same role. The administrator activates the old user record. The user is added to the same default Opportunity teams but is no longer able to see the same records the user worked on before leaving the company. What is the likely cause?
o: The record type of the Opportunity records was changed.
The records were manually shared with the user.
The stage of the Opportunity records was changed to closed lost.
Permission sets were removed when the user was deactivated.
questions.e: Si no hay reglas basadas en criterios y OWD es privado, el acceso extra viene de compartir manualmente el registro.

questions.q: Which tool should an administrator use to review recent configuration changes made in their org?
o: Critical Updates
Debug Logs
Field History Tracking
Setup Audit Trail
questions.e: Setup Audit Trail registra los cambios recientes de configuración (últimos 180 días).

questions.q: The administrator has been asked to automate a simple field update on the account. When a support agent changes the status of the account to 'Audited', they would like the system to automatically update the Audited Date field on the account with today's date. Which tool should the administrator use to complete this automation?
o: Flow Builder
Validation Rule
Approval Process
Formula Field
questions.e: Una actualización simple de campo al cambiar un estado se automatiza con un flow desencadenado por registro.

questions.q: A new sales rep at Ursa Major Solar has a qualified lead that is ready for conversion. When using the Lead conversion process, which two records can be created?
o: Case
Account
Contact
Campaign
questions.e: Al convertir un lead se crean una cuenta, un contacto (y opcionalmente una oportunidad).

questions.q: Cloud Kicks (CK) captures whether an opportunity should be reviewed by someone in product engineering with a checkbox field called Needs Review. CK also has a picklist field on the opportunity for Product Type. When a sales rep saves an opportunity, they need to select the Product Type or check the Needs Review box. What should an administrator use to accomplish this?
o: Before Save flow
Validation rule
Workflow rule
Required fields
questions.e: Una validación exige el motivo de revisión cuando el checkbox Needs Review está marcado.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks has a screen flow with two questions on the same screen, but only one is necessary at a time. The administrator has been asked to show only the question that is needed. How should an administrator complete this?
o: Use branching in the flow screen to show the proper scenario.
Use conditional visibility to hide the unnecessary question.
Use a new version of the flow for each scenario.
Use a decision element and a new screen to show the proper question.
questions.e: Un elemento Decision más pantallas separadas muestra solo la pregunta necesaria.
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar (lo habitual sería visibilidad condicional, opción B).

questions.q: The administrator at Ursa Major Solar wants to add prepopulated subjects for Tasks and Events. Tasks should have the subjects Schedule Site Visit, and Send Contract, while Events should have the subjects Site Visit and Ride Along. How can this requirement be configured?
o: Include Schedule Site Visit, Send Contract, Site Visit, and Ride Along picklist values for the Activity subject field.
Add the new values to the predefined field values for the global actions New Event and New Task.
Add Schedule Site Visit and Send Contract picklist values for the Task subject field. Add Site Visit and Ride Along picklist values for Event subject field.
Create a new custom Subject picklist field on Activity and add the field values.
questions.e: Se añaden los valores a la picklist Subject de Tasks/Events (con record types si difieren por tipo).
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar.

questions.q: DreamHouse Realty needs to use consistent picklist values in the Category field on Accounts and Cases, with values respective to record types. Which two features should the administrator use to fulfill this requirement?
o: Global picklist
Multi-select picklist
Dependent picklist
Custom picklist
questions.e: Una picklist global reutiliza valores en varios campos y una personalizada ajusta valores por record type.
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to initiate expense reports from Salesforce to the external HR system. This process needs to be reviewed by managers and directors. Which two tools should an administrator configure?
o: Outbound Message
Quick Action
Email Alert Action
Approval Process
questions.e: Un proceso de aprobación revisa por managers y un Outbound Message envía datos al sistema externo.

questions.q: The administrator at Ursa Major Solar has been asked to change the Work Item and Project custom object relationship from a master-detail to a lookup. Which scenario could prevent the administrator from fulfilling this requirement?
o: The lookup field in all the records contains a value.
A junction object is required to support the lookup.
Roll-up summary fields exist on the master object.
The lookup field is required for saving records.
questions.e: No se puede convertir master-detail a lookup si existen roll-up summary en el maestro.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks wants a report to categorize accounts into small, medium, and large based on the dollar value found in the Contract Value field. What feature should an administrator use to meet this request?
o: Bucket Column
Filter Logic
Group Rows
Detail Column
questions.e: Bucket Column agrupa valores numéricos en rangos (pequeño, mediano, grande) dentro del informe.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks has decided to delete a custom field. What will happen to the data in the field when it is deleted?
o: The data associated with the field is removed.
The data is restorable from the recycle bin.
The data is permanently deleted.
The data in the field is stored for 20 days.
questions.e: Al eliminar un campo personalizado se eliminan también sus datos (quedan 15 días en la papelera).
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar.

questions.q: Currently, when support reps at Ursa Major Solar close a case, they manually send an email notification to the customer. The support manager would like to automate this process, as too many reps are forgetting this step. Which two settings should the administrator use to meet this request?
o: Case close template in the support settings
Add the Knowledge component to the closed layout
Auto-response rule step set for status of closed
Notify contact checkbox on close page layout
questions.e: La plantilla de cierre de caso o una auto-respuesta con estado Closed envía el email automáticamente.
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar.

questions.q: Ursa Solar Major is evaluating a brand new Salesforce org for its service team and would like to know what objects will be made available with out of the box Service Cloud. Which three of the standard objects are available to an administrator considering a support use case?
o: Case
Request
Ticket
Contract
Account
questions.e: Service Cloud incluye de serie Case, Contract y Account, entre otros.

questions.q: DreamHouse Realty regularly processes customer requests for warranty work and would like to offer customers a self-serve option to generate cases. Which two solutions should an administrator use to meet this request?
o: Case Queues
Email-to-Case
Web-to-case
Case Escalation
questions.e: Para autoservicio de casos: Web-to-Case en el sitio web y Email-to-Case.

questions.q: What is the order of execution when a Case record is saved?
o: Validation rules, Assignment rules, Escalation rules, Auto-response rules
Assignment rules, Validation rules, Workflow rules, Escalation rules
Assignment rules, Auto-response rules, Workflow rules, Escalation rules
Validation rules, Escalation rules, Workflow rules, Auto-response rules
questions.e: Orden al guardar un caso: asignación, auto-respuesta, workflow y escalado.
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks wants to give credit to Opportunity team members based on the level of effort contributed by each person toward each deal. What feature should the administrator use to meet this requirement?
o: List Views
Queues
Stages
Splits
questions.e: Opportunity Splits reparte el crédito del importe entre los miembros del equipo.

questions.q: AW Computing wants to prevent users from updating the Account Annual Revenue field to be a negative value or an amount more than $100 billion. How should an administrator accomplish this request?
o: Enable Account Revenue limits in Setup, with 0 as the minimum and 100 billion as the maximum.
Build a scheduled report displaying Accounts with Account Revenue that is negative or greater than 100 billion.
Make the Account Revenue field required on the page layout.
Create a validation rule that displays an error if Account Revenue is below 0 or greater than 100 billion.
