questions.e: Una validación con límites inferior y superior impide importes negativos o excesivos.

questions.q: What are three settings an administrator should configure to make it easy for approvers to respond to approval requests?
o: Specify initial submission actions within the approval process.
Enable the organization's email approval response setting.
Update the organization's Chatter settings to allow approvals.
Add the Items to Approve component to the approvers' home page.
Create a flow to automatically approve all records.
questions.e: Acciones iniciales, respuesta por email y aprobación vía Chatter facilitan que los aprobadores respondan.
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar.

questions.q: Sales and Customer Care at Ursa Major Solar need to see different fields on the Case related list from the Account record. Sales users want to see Case created date and status while Customer Care would like to see owner, status, and contact. What should the administrator use to achieve this?
o: Compact Layout Editor
Related Lookup Filters
Page Layout Editor
Search Layout Editor
questions.e: Cada perfil ve su propia lista relacionada con columnas distintas mediante page layouts (editor).

questions.q: The sales team at Ursa Major Solar has asked the administrator to automate an outbound message. What should the administrator utilize to satisfy the request?
o: Task Assignment
Case Auto-Response Rule
Record-triggered flow
Process Builder
questions.e: Un record-triggered flow envía el outbound message en reacción al cambio del registro.

questions.q: The VP of sales at DreamHouse Realty has requested a dashboard to visualize enterprise sales across the different teams. The key piece of data is the total of all sales for the year and the progress to the enterprise sales goal. What dashboard component will effectively show this number and the proximity to the total goal as a single value?
o: Table
Donut
Gauge
Stacked Bar
questions.e: El gráfico Gauge muestra un total frente a un objetivo.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks (CK) has a new administrator who is asked to put together a memo detailing Salesforce usage to budget for upcoming license purchases. Where should the administrator go to find out what type of licenses CK has purchased and how many are available?
o: User management settings in setup
Usage-based entitlements related list in company information
User licenses related list in company information
Search for licenses types in setup
questions.e: En Company Information → User Licenses se ven licencias asignadas y disponibles.

questions.q: Universal Containers is trying to improve the user experience when searching for the right status on a case. The company currently has one support process that is used for all record types on cases. The support process has 10 status values. Service reps say they never need more than five depending on what kind of case they are working on. How should the administrator improve on the current implementation?
o: Edit the status choices directly on the record type.
Create a Screen Flow that shows only the correct values for status and surface the flow in the utility bar of the console.
Review which status choices are needed for each record type and create support processes for each that is necessary.
Reduce the number of case status values to five.
questions.e: Se crean support processes con solo los estados necesarios para cada record type.

questions.q: The administrator for AW Computing is working with a user who is having trouble logging in to Salesforce. What should the administrator do to identify why the user is unable to log in?
o: Check the attempted logins by running the setup audit trail.
Pull the password history to ensure the password policy was followed.
Reset the security token for the profile.
Review the login history for the user.
questions.e: Reiniciar el token de seguridad corrige fallos de acceso a la API, pero lo habitual para diagnosticar un login es consultar el historial de inicios de sesión.
questions.note: Respuesta seleccionada por el examinado en la prueba; lo habitual es revisar el Login History. Verificar.

questions.q: At Ursa Major Solar, a flow is in place that sends a reminder email 30 days before the warranty expiration date. A customer renews their warranty for another three years. What is the expected behavior of the email element in the flow?
o: The email is not sent because the customer's email address was missing.
The email is locked in the job queue until it meets the criteria.
The email is sent with the 30 day reminder criteria.
The email is not sent because the record no longer meets the criteria.
questions.e: Si el registro ya no cumple el criterio (fecha cambiada), el flow programado no envía el correo.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to track ROI for contacts that are key stakeholders for opportunities. The VP of sales requested that this information be accessible on the opportunity and available for reporting. Which two options should the administrator configure to meet these requirements?
o: Add the Campaign Member related list to the Opportunity page layout.
Add the Opportunity Contact Role related list to the Opportunity page layout.
Customize Campaign Member Role.
Customize Campaign Role.
Customize Opportunity Contact Role.
questions.e: Se añade la lista relacionada Opportunity Contact Role y se personaliza para trazar el ROI.
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar.

questions.q: Which three items are available in the mobile navigation menu?
o: Dashboards
Lightning Home Page
Lightning App Pages
Chatter
Utility Bar
questions.e: El menú de navegación móvil incluye dashboards, Lightning App Pages y Chatter, entre otros.
questions.note: Respuesta marcada por quien hizo el examen; sin verificar.

questions.q: DreamHouse Realty wants to offer a form on its Experience Cloud site where inspectors will submit findings from a property inspection. Which feature should an administrator place on the page to fulfill this requirement?
o: Screen Flow
Record Detail
Autolaunched Flow
Related List
questions.e: Un screen flow publicado en Experience Cloud recoge el formulario de inspección.

questions.q: Which setting on a profile makes a tab hidden in the All App Launcher or visible in any app, but still allows a user to view records that would normally be found under this tab?
o: Object Permissions
App Permissions
Tab Settings
Org-wide Defaults
questions.e: Tab Settings (Default Off) oculta la pestaña del lanzador pero deja ver los registros.
questions.note: Texto de la opción C reconstruido a partir de un OCR dudoso; sin verificar.

questions.q: A sales rep has a list of 300 accounts with contacts that they want to load at one time. Which tool should the administrator utilize to import the records to Salesforce?
o: Data Import Wizard
Data Loader
Dataloader.io
Manual Import
questions.e: Para 300 cuentas con contactos, el Data Import Wizard es suficiente (hasta 50.000 registros).
